speaker: A
word: Have you seen how much we’ve spent on the AI API this month?
translation: Você viu quanto gastamos com a API de IA este mês?
pronunciation: /hæv juː siːn haʊ mʌtʃ wiːv spɛnt ɑːn ði ˌeɪˈaɪ ˌeɪpiːˈaɪ ðɪs mʌnθ/
portuguesePhonetic: [rév iú sín ráu mâtch uív spént ón di ÊI-ÁI êi-pi-ÁI dis mânf]

speaker: B
word: Yeah. It was much higher than I expected.
translation: Vi. Ficou bem acima do que eu esperava.
pronunciation: /jɛə ɪt wʌz mʌtʃ ˈhaɪər ðæn aɪ ɪkˈspɛktɪd/
portuguesePhonetic: [ié. ít uâz mâtch RAI-âr dén ái ik-SPÉK-tid]

speaker: A
word: Could the application be making unnecessary calls?
translation: Será que a aplicação está fazendo chamadas desnecessárias?
pronunciation: /kʊd ði ˌæplɪˈkeɪʃən biː ˈmeɪkɪŋ ʌnˈnɛsəsɛri kɔːlz/
portuguesePhonetic: [kûd di é-pli-KÊI-shân bi MÊI-kin ân-NÉ-sâ-sé-ri kólz]

speaker: B
word: Possibly. I’ll check the token usage per task.
translation: Pode ser. Vou verificar o consumo de tokens por tarefa.
pronunciation: /ˈpɑːsəbli aɪl tʃɛk ðə ˈtoʊkən ˈjuːsɪdʒ pɜːr tæsk/
portuguesePhonetic: [PÓ-sâ-bli. áil tchék dâ TÔU-kân IÚ-sidj pâr tésk]

speaker: A
word: Great. Then we can set up spending alerts.
translation: Ótimo. Depois podemos definir alertas de gastos.
pronunciation: /ɡreɪt ðɛn wiː kæn sɛt ʌp ˈspɛndɪŋ əˈlɜːrts/
portuguesePhonetic: [grêit. dén uí kén sét âp SPÉN-din a-LÂRTS]
